evals.prompt: I have a React design system with Storybook and I want to set up an MCP server so my team can query components programmatically. We use Netlify for deployment. Can you help me set this up? Our components are in src/ui/components/ and stories are in src/ui/components/**/__stories__/*.stories.tsx
evals.expected_output: Scaffold MCP server with Netlify functions entry point, metadata extraction script, tool registry, AND generate MCP_SETUP.md documentation explaining the architecture, tools, and workflow.

assertions.name: mentions_netlify_entry_point
assertions.description: Response mentions Netlify Functions entry point

assertions.name: adapts_custom_paths
assertions.description: Response adapts to user's custom component paths (src/ui/components)

assertions.name: generates_documentation
assertions.description: Response includes or mentions generating MCP_SETUP.md documentation

assertions.name: explains_architecture
assertions.description: Documentation explains the MCP architecture rationale

assertions.name: documents_tools
assertions.description: Documentation lists and explains available tools

evals.prompt: I already have an MCP server set up for my design system. I want to add a new tool called 'search-components' that lets AI assistants search components by name pattern. Can you add this tool and update the documentation?
evals.expected_output: Create mcp/tools/search-components.ts with proper handler, schema, register it in mcp/tools/index.ts, AND update MCP_SETUP.md with the new tool documentation including rationale.

assertions.name: creates_tool_file
assertions.description: Response includes content for search-components.ts tool file

assertions.name: updates_tool_registry
assertions.description: Response shows how to register tool in index.ts

assertions.name: documents_rationale
assertions.description: Documentation includes rationale for the new tool
